No impact to contract completion date
Float is consumed; document the float consumed

The activity becomes critical
Treat as if it IS on the critical path

span.p: Who caused the delay?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Excusable and compensable:
Time extension + additional cost recovery
Issue a TIA within the contract notice period

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Excusable non-compensable:
Time extension only — no additional cost unless contract says otherwise
Issue time-extension notice within contract period

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Non-excusable:
No time extension; may be liable for LDs if past completion date
Build a recovery schedule immediately

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Concurrent delay — entitlement is jurisdiction-specific
Document both party's delays contemporaneously
Seek legal counsel before submitting a TIA

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Submit TIA: as-planned fragnet + narrative + notice letter
Copy all required contract parties

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Issue recovery schedule within the contract notice period
Document acceleration costs if directed
